text:
maria: Putting up the internal release notes draft for tonight's EU change window (02:00-04:00 UTC). Need copy pass + confirm pin target and rollback owner. @ajay can you take rollback?

ajay: I can take rollback. Please confirm commit hash and whether we pin to v3.2.1 or v3.3-rc. Also say if rollout is staged or full.

maria: We'll pin stable v3.2.1. Commit 0a1b2c3d. Draft snippet below — tiny edits welcome.

```
- Performance: Improved token batching to reduce tail-latency (~15% median).
- Fix: Gateway retries caused duplicate logs in rare cases (workaround: recycle sidecar pod).
- Risk: Canary cohort may experience transient 502 errors for a small fraction of requests.
```

sophie: Suggest "recycle sidecar pod" for clarity. Also prefer "Canary cohort" over "Canary users".

leo: We should add an explicit rollback bullet with owner + exact command. e.g., 'Rollback: pin back to v3.2.0 using `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0` (Ajay)'.

ajay: I'll be rollback owner. My plan: `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason "502 spike"` then monitor latency and error-rate for 10m. Hold until ops-oncall gives the go.

katie: Copy tweak: expand 'transient 502 errors' -> 'transient 502 errors affecting a small fraction of requests'. Otherwise looks good.

maria: Great. Scheduling: canary start at 02:15 UTC. @deploybot please schedule canary, 20m window, ping ops-oncall at 10m gate.

deploybot: Scheduled: canary deploy v3.2.1 at 2025-06-18T02:15:00Z (UTC). Canary window: 20m. Will notify @ops-oncall at 10m. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/release-runbooks/v3.2.1

ops-oncall: I'll monitor. Trigger conditions: if 502 rate > 1% sustained for 5m or error spike >2x baseline, I'll ask Ajay to run rollback. Ajay: wait for my confirmation before executing.

ajay: Copy. Also confirm we set serving pin policy to 'allowlist' and pin commit 0a1b2c3d in orchestrator before launch.

sophie: One more: Legal asked for an explicit line 'No API changes' so customers aren't confused — can we add that?

maria: Added: 'No API changes; behavior updates limited to performance and telemetry.'

leo: Final internal draft:

```
Internal release notes (v3.2.1 - internal draft):
- Performance: Improved token batching to reduce tail-latency (~15% median).
- Fix: Gateway retries causing duplicate logs in rare cases (workaround: recycle sidecar pod).
- Risk: Canary cohort may observe transient 502 errors affecting a small fraction of requests. Ops will monitor; rollback owner: Ajay.
- Rollback: Pin back to v3.2.0 via `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason \"502 spike\"` (Ajay).
- Customer impact: No API changes; updates limited to performance and telemetry.
```

maria: If everyone :thumbsup: I'll lock this in 30m and queue the internal blast. Ops-oncall, confirm you'll watch the 10m gate?

ops-oncall: Confirmed. I'll give green at 10m if metrics look steady, otherwise will call rollback.

maria: Thanks all — locking copy unless objections. :lock:
